name: motion-spring
description: Motion animate() translateX 0->200px, spring stiffness 300, damping 20, mass 1, on click. durationMs is the 2% settle time of the exact response (last time it leaves the 0.98 to 1.02 band), 340 ms; zeta = c / (2 * sqrt(k * m)) = 0.577. The envelope bound ln(1 / 0.02) / (c / 2m) = 391 ms is an upper limit, not the settle time.
